routes.label: Project the hexagons and dissect the rim

before.rationale: The regular hexagons' 120° interior angles determine the horizontal components of their shared edges. These locate the level rim octagon, which can be evaluated as a square with four corner triangles removed.

Complete the top view using unit-square corner gaps

after.rationale: The level rim can be located by the stored unit-square-gap geometry or by projecting regular-hexagon components. In top view, complete the octagon to a square and subtract four corner triangles; the geometric gap route does not require evaluating trigonometric values.
